design_matrix: RP0 has source=none and level=control; RP1 has levels EDR_only/NDR_only; RP2-RP7 instantiate every Cartesian child in source_family=[EDR,NDR] x the registered levels; no source is randomly selected

replay.mapping: emit canonical base byte stream unchanged
retain exactly the named source family and remove the other; preserve order; SourceCoverage unchanged
for each event of the explicit child source in canonical order drop iff U('drop',source_family||0x1f||event_id)<level; retain all events of the other source

replay.candidate_order: ascending unique integer-microsecond event_time t from the explicit source satisfying t+level*1000000<=run_end_us
replay.mapping: remove explicit-source events in [candidate[j],candidate[j]+level seconds); retain the other source; candidate_count=0 invalidates child
add exactly level*1000000 integer microseconds to ingest_time of every explicit-source event; event_time, other source, and SourceCoverage unchanged

replay.anchor: minimum ingest_time_us over the complete base stream
replay.mapping: within each buffer reorder explicit-source events by (U('permute',source_family||0x1f||event_id),event_id UTF-8); retain timestamps and positions of other-source events, then merge by ingest_time and canonical tie order
add exactly level*1000000 signed integer microseconds to event_time of every explicit-source event; ingest_time, other source, and SourceCoverage unchanged

replay.selection: for each ascending dependency_group of the explicit source duplicate the complete group once iff U('duplicate',source_family||0x1f||dependency_group)<level
replay.mapping: duplicate event_id=lowercase hex SHA-256(duplicate_id_preimage), ingest_time_us=original+1, and preserve all other fields including dependency_group; hash collision invalidates child

physical_outage.population: dedicated locked-test attack_only cohort; excluded from the 220 base runs and from training, development, calibration, RT2, RT3a, and RT3b
physical_outage.design_matrix: source_family [EDR,NDR] x outage_duration_seconds [120,600] x repetition_index [0,9], yielding exactly 40 physical traces

allocation.balance_invariant: the 40-cell expansion assigns exactly 10 traces to each representative card
allocation.ordering: source family order EDR,NDR; duration order 120,600; repetition index ascending

physical_outage.comparator_reuse: TrustEpisode and OB1_available_source_denominator are evaluated from the same immutable raw trace and SourceCoverage journal; an outage is never repeated per comparator

timestamp_contract.t_anchor: start of the first interval with two immediately preceding healthy heartbeats, parser_valid=true, transport_live=true, and backlog_seconds<=120
timestamp_contract.t_stop: t_anchor+120 seconds, valid only if all health predicates remain continuously true on [t_anchor,t_stop)
timestamp_contract.t_ready: first timestamp at or after t_restore beginning two consecutive heartbeat intervals with parser_valid=true, transport_live=true, and backlog_seconds<=120
timestamp_contract.detection_censoring: if no t_detect<t_restore, detection is right-censored at t_restore and t_detect is null
timestamp_contract.recovery_censoring: if t_ready or t_stable is absent by t_censor, recovery is right-censored at t_censor and the absent timestamp is null

physical_outage.action: at t_stop, stop all manifest-registered collector egress process IDs for exactly the selected source family within one second; restore the same IDs at t_restore; do not stop targets, packet capture, control-plane services, or network interfaces

source_action_resolver.EDR: the UTF-8-sorted endpoint telemetry egress process IDs for edr-target-01 and edr-target-02
source_action_resolver.NDR: the single Suricata EVE transport/forwarder process ID in ndr-gateway; packet capture and local EVE spooling remain live

physical_outage.recovery_criterion: two consecutive healthy heartbeat intervals, parser_valid=true, backlog_seconds<=L_watermark_seconds, then no new revision for W_revision_seconds
physical_outage.safety_abort: abort if collector stop affects the control plane or a non-laboratory route
